_description: server/data/quest_extras.json: the Daily, Weekly, Event and challenge (Challenge) tabs of the quest window and quests not in the wiki (roadmap E6). quest.py serves them together with those of quests.json. Generated by: tools/quest_extras.py.
_source: recording (id, type, level, icon, priority, previous quest; start of the daily and weekly selection), client (title, description of the challenges and of "Level N" quests), fandom (Mission list: Tetrathrin and Kyhalon quests; Blacklight missions; quest and challenge pages), darkorbitwiki (Epic Missions, Blacklight missions, Challenges: coordinate, MISCELLANEOUS, ammunition restriction, score, recipe and Blacklight Trace conditions; Epic Missions (level 22), Elite Missions (100 quests), Daily Missions (level pools) and Special Missions (event quests); the "source" field says which one was used)
_adaptation: Conditions and rewards of the event quests (501021-501025); the unranked version of the challenges (score, completion time, no reward: darkorbitwiki gives none either); ENDURANCE durations in ms (like TIMER; unverified); "Level N" quests have no reward; coordinate arrival has a 500-unit radius (the client only displays it); there is no counter display (TIMER) such as "Hurry up!", the time limit is shown with HASTE; X-4 Mission Control does not exist in the client, turn-ins are at any quest giver; booster_ep-b01 / booster_cd-b01 guessed from darkorbitwiki reward names; company-specific challenges (17/186/187, 170/181/182, 190/191/192) are visible only to that company's pilot; Eradication (122006) reward is 25,000,000 Honor per official Turkish forum 149871 (the wiki said Uridium); the damage condition of elite quests "Damage Enemy Players" uses the recorded DAMAGE_PLAYERS (30) form, "Damage NPCs" uses the targetless DAMAGE_NPCS; weapon conditions ("using R-310 rockets", "with lasers", "without using rockets") are not measured (the kill event does not carry the weapon, the client has no such sub-condition): in these quests only the target counts; "Complete Compromising Invasion Galaxy Gate" is tied to the ISTILA_GATE event of event_gate.py (not in the client's GalaxyGateType names: condition text not verified live); in level-pool dailies Armory Token is only in those where it appears in the wiki row, level 3 quests come from the player's company leader; Prosperous quests (506641-506644) from the client titles and fandom values (the Prosperous Mutation dailies named New Horizons / Cosmic Crisis / Peace Treaty / Ray Of Hope on the darkorbitwiki page have no title in the client); Winter Birthday #1 506587-506592, #2 516593-516598 (two id families each in the client); Hitac Assault twin ids 510143-510145 not added; Chaos Omen / Astral Ascension epics mapped to client names (Going Dark = Cleaning, Survive Death = It’s Getting Dark, Into the Unknown = Unknown, Double Down = Double Effort); Freighter Protection (500483) was not added as a quest because it is given by the daily adaptation in mimesis.py; Permafrost Fissure quests (506233-506235) have no calendar key (the gate is always open with the CPU), rewards from fandom values. Old event quests from the official Turkish forum (506156-506160 Saimon Rebellion, 10th Anniversary 506201-506229 / 512210-512216, Epidemic Alert 506248-506267 / 512248-512267, Blacklight Surge 517306-517315): conditions and rewards from the forum tables; "SG-03/SG-02" FS-03/FS-02, "Cross-Server Map" 4-4, Blacklight Surge dailies without day order; of the failure conditions only death is measured.
